institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
milestone: Phase 5 Step 6 — Multi-Agent StateGraph Orchestration & Human Gate Routing
verdict_justification: The complete ManuMind AI multi-agent LangGraph StateGraph orchestration workflow has been implemented, validated, and verified across 40 dedicated orchestration tests and the complete 185-test Phase 5 regression suite (100% pass rate). The compiled graph (build_manumind_graph) seamlessly connects the independently implemented Supervisor Agent, Anomaly Detection Agent, and Root Cause Analysis Agent with two dedicated governance and execution boundary nodes: the Verification Governance Node and the Human Approval Gate Node. Acyclic progression guards guarantee deterministic termination and prevent infinite re-execution loops. All safety and security invariants are strictly enforced: worker agents are forbidden from mutating human approval or verification channels, hypotheses remain strictly UNVERIFIED until external review, and Phase 4 ticket creation remains isolated behind the HMAC approval boundary with zero unauthorized token minting.

nodes.description: Orchestrates workflow, validates state updates, evaluates policy, and dynamically routes
Consumes 5-channel telemetry and executes ML anomaly inference pipeline with SHAP explanation
Corroborates evidence across maintenance history and technical manuals, producing candidate hypotheses
Evaluates candidate hypotheses, enforces source diversity (>=2), caps synthetic scores (<=0.70), and preserves unverified status
Governs operator sign-off, halts workflow in WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL on PENDING, and enforces HMAC boundary

acyclic_safeguards.anomaly_cycle_prevention: route_from_supervisor redirects to human_approval_gate if anomaly_detection_result already exists
acyclic_safeguards.rca_cycle_prevention: route_from_supervisor redirects to human_approval_gate if RCA has already executed
acyclic_safeguards.post_rca_supervisor_evaluation: supervisor.py explicitly evaluates completed RCA without candidate hypotheses and routes to human gate rather than re-triggering RCA

security_boundaries.ticket_tool_boundary: create_maintenance_ticket tool is never exposed to worker agents or supervisor graph; requires external valid HMAC token
security_boundaries.token_minting_boundary: Neither Supervisor nor worker agents have access to token minting secret or HMAC generation keys
security_boundaries.unverified_lifecycle: Candidate hypotheses remain UNVERIFIED; independent verification requires authoritative external operator sign-off
